note: bin/hub of one version, only the input differs: "before" — the message as the core typed it before ("The owner to executor X: …" and an unrelated FYI block), "after" — with the core's service note (reducer._bus_note). "Pass on" — a `hub session wake notes-ci --about d22` (asleep; a mini-hub wakes only with --about its task) or `hub send notes-ci` (working) call. Names and texts are made up.

You don't remember their syntax: before typing a hub command, look at the help (`hub --help`, `hub <command> --help`). A late or duplicate internal report with nothing new for the owner: finish quietly with “—”. End the turn with one line: what you did. Today is 2026-11-10, the owner's time.
